nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Hi, Tom! How was your weekend?
It was great, thanks! On Saturday, I visited my grandparents in the country.
Oh, nice! Were they happy to see you?
Very happy! My grandmother cooked a huge lunch, and after lunch we played cards all afternoon. Then my grandfather showed me his garden. It's beautiful.
What about you? Were you busy?
Oh, yes! On Saturday morning, I cleaned my whole apartment, and then I washed my car. In the evening, I stayed at home and watched two movies.
The first one was really funny. The second one was terrible. I stopped it after twenty minutes!
On Sunday it rained all day, so I studied for my English exam. I practiced my listening for three hours.
